name: Britpop
summary: The aesthetic, which became a key part of the larger cultural moment known as Cool Britannia , was defined by a strong emphasis on British national identity and working-class pride.
description: The aesthetic, which became a key part of the larger cultural moment known as Cool Britannia , was defined by a strong emphasis on British national identity and working-class pride. Britpop translated its sonic reverence for the past into a distinctly British style that merged elements of Mod culture, casuals , and punk -derived irreverence. [ 2 ]
culturalContext: Key values (per the Aesthetics Wiki): British national identity, youthful exuberance, anti-Americanism (anti- Grunge ), nostalgia for the 1960s, irony

visualDNA.colour: Red, white, and blue (referencing the Union Jack); khaki/olive (parkas); navy/black (suit jackets)
